Dear Larkspur team,

I am writing to secure the Veloce for a client event. The arrangements will be as follows: we will collect the vehicle from your garage on Thu 2 Jun 2027 at 11:30 and will return it by 3 June 2027 at 12:30. I would like to request that the vehicle be made available to us with a chauffeur. I have attached my driving licence.

Best wishes,
Quentin Dunsmere +70 704 776 2836
